items.description: This uses Mera Caar API hosted on Heroku and has its specification on Programmable Web at https://www.programmableweb.com/api/mera-caar. It uses the API for the very purpose the API was created in the first place - to guide the viewer about the components present inside a generic car.
Windshield Repair Tech is a web application demonstrating windshield repair tech api.

View satellite imagery at full screen, dynamic update to the URL for every move of the view. Bookmark current view and come back later, or shows your friends for a particular location. Lets you populate articles and photos to current view.
CashFly is a cash point (ATM) locator for the UK. The site is integrated with Google Maps and calculates cash points nearest to you using your current latitude and longitude.
Google Maps + Twitter view of Unemployed in America. Tweets split into Eastern/Western United States.
Free PBX for SMS and phone calls with random strangers, while keeping your number and identity private.
Track the most popular news and other threads online via RSSmeme. Integrates with FriendFeed API.
Storefront built on Amazon eCommerce with millions of products from a wide variety of categories and hundreds of merchants with competitive prices.
Find where the nearest Starbucks is for each of the OnAIR bus tour stops.
Use a Google Map to find NYC drink specials by neighborhood and day.
Whatsikat Boso shows how Filipino bloggers are feeling right now. It extracts feelings from Filipino blogs. Take a peek into their moods and see how that makes you feel.

Twitter voice search in multiple languages. Features include Search-by-Voice, Search-as-You-Type, Real-time Search Suggestions, Did you say Speech-to-Text Corrections, Real-Time Update Notifications and 66 Speech-to-Text Languages.
